# Pike

Type: Fish | Internal ID: fish2 | Source: Fishing | Usage: Decoration | Cooking | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

Pike are coastal fish found offshore the Meadows and Black Forest. They can be caught with a fishing rod using Cold fishing bait which can be crafted at the Food preparation table by combining 20 Fishing bait and a Fenring trophy.

### Crafting

• Fishing hat
• Raw fish

## Notes

• Has a unique line: "You're supposed to put heads on a pike, not put a pike on a wall..."

Categorias: Fish
